title: Sale Ad Creatives With Editable Offers | AIVideosUGC
description: Build a sale ad creative from one product photo. Add the confirmed price, code and end date after download, then reuse the scene when the promotion changes.
lead: Paste a product link and get sale ad creatives with a script, an actor, and a voiceover, while the price and the code are still open.

faq.q: Will the discount be printed on the image for me?
faq.a: The product link can bring the item details in. You still confirm the percent, the price, the code, and the end date in the built-in editor, so you can check every character.

faq.q: Can I reuse the scene for the next promotion?
faq.a: Yes. The product scene is separate from the offer. Replace the text, the voiceover, or the timer when the promotion changes and keep the same visual.

faq.q: Can I show the old price next to the sale price?
faq.a: Only if you actually charged that old price. Check the comparison-pricing rules where you sell before you publish the claim.

faq.q: Can I change the timer on the sale video?
faq.a: Yes. Set the end time in the built-in editor and move it if the window changes. You control when the countdown stops.

faq.q: How many credits does a sale photo or video use?
faq.a: A photo uses 24 credits. Video uses 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30. The cost shows before you start, and a failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Can the sale ad use an actor from the library?
faq.a: Yes. Pick one, describe a look, or build one from a short clip of you. If a person appears, that person is generated, not a real customer or a celebrity.

faq.q: Can I publish the file as a paid sale ad?
faq.a: Yes. Publish in one click to TikTok, Instagram, or Meta, or download it. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark. The platform's ad rules still apply.

faq.q: Can I make sale ads for many products at once?
faq.a: Yes. Batch mode takes a set of product links and returns one ad each. Review every file before it is published.

faq.q: Can the ad start from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page and the photos and details come in as a storyboard. You can also upload one product photo.

faq.q: Can my store request sale ads through an API?
faq.a: Yes. The API lets your store ask for a sale ad from a product link. The file stays in your account until you share it.

faq.q: Can I add a voiceover, music, and captions?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an AI voice, a track from the music library, and automatic captions. The same script can be spoken in another language.

faq.q: What frame should the sale video use?
faq.a: A product photo is square. A clip from the same photo runs 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds, in 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. Each video is its own job.

faq.q: How much empty space should I leave for the offer?
faq.a: Leave clear room for the offer line and the code without covering the product. Check the smallest screen you will use and make sure both stay readable.

reviews.h2: How shops make a sale banner for an online store
reviews.lead: Three ways a shop leaves room for an offer that is not final yet.

items.t: Leave open space beside the jar
items.d: They paste the product link and ask for a clean counter with empty room on one side. The percent off is typed later, so a changed number does not need a new scene.

items.t: Run the jacket scene again next week
items.d: They keep the same jacket scene and swap the actor's line for the next code. Only the offer text in the editor changes.

items.t: Fold the blanket, then set the timer
items.d: They show the blanket in use and set the end time in the editor once the sale window is real.
